propositions: Cloud's three whole-project ACLI readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) paginate via opaque nextPageToken cursor but have no test exercising more than one page
Existing test coverage (mutate/test_acli_cross_mixin_binding.py:188,200) only feeds single-page payloads with isLast=True, leaving cursor advancement and multi-page termination untested

The same defect class shipped three times on DC side (change 1105, rebar:9263-b404-cb6c-463f, rebar:deac-4f5a-856a-49bd) and was fixed only after production discovery, creating risk that Cloud copies will regress silently
Cursor loop termination depends on both isLast and nextPageToken presence; neither condition's isolation is tested, and no guard prevents adding a fourth unpaginated whole-project reader on Cloud
A separate real defect (rebar:cabc-7a98-d173-4d7c) was found: repeated cursor tokens cause infinite spin with fail-open exception handling, making symptoms invisible to the differ as partial maps
